children: ALSTOM S.A: ALSTOM AND TRANSPENNINE EXPRESS SIGN €1.2 BILLION CONTRACTS FOR BRITAIN’S FIRST MAINLINE BATTERY-ELECTRIC TRAINS
THOUSANDS OF UK JOBS SUPPORTED THROUGH ALSTOM SUPPLY CHAIN
ORDER FOR ROLLING STOCK WORTH AROUND 930 MILLION EUROS AND MAINTENANCE CONTRACTS WORTH APPROXIMATELY 230 MILLION EUROS
THE FLEET WILL BE DELIVERED FROM 2032
WILL SUPPORT MORE THAN 350 HIGHLY SKILLED JOBS IN DERBY AND OVER 5,500 ROLES THROUGHOUT ALSTOM UK SUPPLY CHAIN
MANUFACTURING IS EXPECTED TO BEGIN IN 2028
